summary: A start that is only paperwork leaves a new hire feeling little tie to the employer and ready to leave early.
realLife: Gallup reported that only about 12 percent of employees strongly agree their employer onboards well, and tied weak onboarding to a weak bond with the company and early exits.
sources: Gallup, Why the onboarding experience is key for retention: https://www.gallup.com/workplace/235121/why-onboarding-experience-key-retention.aspx
inGame: job-ended event by quitting soon after a start date; a new-coworker event with no ties formed.

turns.summary: The new hire leaves within a few weeks.
A coworker takes the new hire to lunch and the bond forms.
The new hire stays but stays aloof.
